title: EXPERIMENTAL CHOICES HOLD FOR THE RAID
why: Job 61 requires all switches to be fixed at raid start with the host choices in both windows. Glow and haul still read live preferences.
now: Experimental choices hold for the whole raid. Both windows use the host choices, including needed-item glow and the result haul.

edits.anchor: function xfSnap(){ var i, k; XF={}; for(i=0;i<XF_WORLD.length;i++){ k=XF_WORLD[i]; XF[k]=(CFG&&CFG[k]===0)?0:1; } return XF; }
edits.replacement:
// v28.xx (cw-cx-expsnap): job 61 says switches are read once at raid start and the host rules in both windows. Include the four formerly local keys.
function xfSnap(){ var i, k; XF={}; for(i=0;i<XF_KEYS.length;i++){ k=XF_KEYS[i]; XF[k]=(CFG&&CFG[k]===0)?0:1; } return XF; }

edits.anchor: function xfL(k){ return !(CFG&&CFG[k]===0); }            // a LOCAL switch, this window, now
edits.replacement:
// v28.xx (cw-cx-expsnap): a guest restores its own CFG after netUpStart, so raid-time local calls must read the host snapshot too. Outside a raid the shop and party-seed controls act on the next run.
function xfL(k){ return (typeof G!=='undefined'&&G&&!G.sim&&!G.over)?xf(k):!(CFG&&CFG[k]===0); }

edits.anchor: if(!xfL('xfHaul')) return 0;   // v32.xx (cw-expmenu6): switched off, the haul on the extracted card shows at once
edits.replacement: if(!xf('xfHaul')) return 0;   // v28.xx (cw-cx-expsnap): the result card keeps this raid choice after G.over, including the host choice for a linked window
